description: This file implements ticker scheduling and trigger functions for the Nordic Semiconductor's Bluetooth controller, specifically for the RV32M1 platform. It manages different caller IDs, schedules tasks via mayfly enqueue, and sets trigger values in the counter.

methods.name: hal_ticker_instance0_caller_id_get
methods.description: Returns the caller ID based on user ID, using a lookup table.

methods.name: hal_ticker_instance0_sched
methods.description: Schedules a ticker task based on caller and callee IDs, enqueuing mayfly tasks accordingly.

methods.name: hal_ticker_instance0_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets the trigger value in the counter hardware.
